page_title: NAP 2-3 BOL | Napoli v Bologna 11/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
90+1' 2 - 3 GOAL! Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) gets to the rebound inside the box and fires in a stunning overhead kick. Phenomenal finish! 2:3.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The flag is raised and Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is offside again, not for the first time today.
87' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Miguel Gutierrez is replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
87' Scott McTominay (Napoli) reacts quickest to a cross from Leonardo Spinazzola, but slams his header well wide of the left post from around the penalty spot.
85' It's time for a substitution. Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) comes on in place of Matteo Politano.
84' Matteo Politano (Napoli) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Eivind Fauske Helland walks off the pitch to be replaced by Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna).
81' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Lewis Ferguson and he is replaced by Simon Sohm (Bologna).
81' Substitution. Tommaso Pobega did his best and is replaced by Nikola Moro (Bologna).
81' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli), who has already been caught several times today.

79' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
79' Alisson Santos (Napoli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

77' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
76' Here comes a substitution. Eljif Elmas (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Giovane.
76' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. Stanislav Lobotka will be replaced by Billy Gilmour (Napoli).
73' Federico Bernardeschi goes off the pitch and Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) comes on.
72' So close! Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
70' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Napoli.
69' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Piccinini had an easy-decision to make.
66' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:4.
64' That's the end of the game for Joao Mario, who is replaced by Nadir Zortea (Bologna).
61' A pass from Giovane (Napoli) is intercepted by Massimo Pessina and the move breaks down.
58' The booking goes to Eivind Fauske Helland (Bologna).
56' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
55' The foul by Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) was seen by Marco Piccinini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
55' Alisson Santos (Napoli) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
55' A pass from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is intercepted by Massimo Pessina and the move breaks down.
52' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
50' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
48' 2 - 2 Goal - 2:2! Rasmus Hojlund laid the ball off to Alisson Santos (Napoli), who shot from close range into the right side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
47' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) has tested the patience of referee Marco Piccinini and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

47' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
46' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is about to take a corner kick.
46' Referee Marco Piccinini blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Alisson Santos (Napoli) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Massimo Pessina has no trouble gathering it.
45+2' 1 - 2 GOAL! Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) got to the ball in front of the goal and he couldn't miss from there. His strike went in off the inside of the right-hand post. The score is 1:2.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
43' Bologna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

42' Scott McTominay (Napoli) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
41' Giovane (Napoli) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
40' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joao Mario (Bologna) was quite harsh and Marco Piccinini didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' 0 - 2 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
34' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
34' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
32' Referee Marco Piccinini makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
32' One of the Bologna players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
30' Scott McTominay (Napoli) shows good awareness inside the box to meet a delightful cross from the free kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
30' There's an opportunity for Alisson Santos (Napoli) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
29' Alisson Santos (Napoli) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
29' Matteo Politano (Napoli) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Corner kick. Napoli will have an opportunity.
27' Matteo Politano (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Massimo Pessina, who smothers the ball.
24' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
23' Matteo Politano (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
21' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for an infringement.
18' 47:53 – the latest ball possession ratio.
14' A snap shot by Alisson Santos (Napoli) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Massimo Pessina produces a good save to thwart him.

13' Giovane (Napoli) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the bottom right corner, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Massimo Pessina.
13' It should have been a goal! Juan Miranda (Bologna) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!

10' 0 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the top right corner of the net.
8' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) commits a foul and Marco Piccinini immediately signals a free kick.
7' Alisson Santos (Napoli) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
5' Alisson Santos (Napoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

5' Good play from Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) gives him some space for the shot from distance, but it's lacking accuracy and goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
3' Giovane (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
Bologna will kick-off.
Marco Piccinini is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
